message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.ok.en: Something huge stirs in the water outside the dome
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.ok.zh: 穹顶外的水里，有个大家伙醒了

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.gam.en: Only a player in survival or adventure mode can wake the altar
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.gam.zh: 只有生存或冒险模式的玩家能唤醒祭坛

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.pea.en: Nothing answers the altar on Peaceful difficulty
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.pea.zh: 和平难度下，祭坛没有回应

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.use.en: This altar has already been woken today; come back tomorrow
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.use.zh: 这座祭坛今天已经唤醒过了，明天再来

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.occ.en: Another boss is already nearby; deal with it first
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.occ.zh: 附近已经有一只首领，先把它解决掉

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.den.en: This altar sits on land you are not allowed to change
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.den.zh: 这座祭坛所在的地方不归你管，唤醒不了

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.not.en: Hold a Tide Crystal and use the altar (costs %s Tide Crystals and %s Aberrant Heart)
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.not.zh: 手里拿着潮晶再右键祭坛（要潮晶 ×%s、异变之心 ×%s）

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.mis.en: Not enough: waking the altar costs %s Tide Crystals and %s Aberrant Heart
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.mis.zh: 材料不够：唤醒祭坛要潮晶 ×%s、异变之心 ×%s

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.blo.en: There is no open water outside the dome for anything to come out
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.blo.zh: 穹顶外找不到够大的水，什么都出不来

message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.spa.en: The altar flickers, but nothing comes
message.essentialcraft5.sunken_altar.spa.zh: 祭坛闪了一下，什么都没来

message.essentialcraft5.abyss_tyrant.cla.en: You already collected the Abyssal Tidelord's reward today
message.essentialcraft5.abyss_tyrant.cla.zh: 今天已经领过渊潮领主的奖励了
